name: Vuzora Discovery Agent
description: Read-only agent over Vuzora's published catalogue. It reports which Russian universities have a published Vuzora page and returns the Markdown mirror of any public page. It does not deliver timetables, and Vuzora is not an official university service.

skills.name: University coverage lookup
skills.description: Given a university name, abbreviation, or slug, answers whether Vuzora publishes a page for it and returns that page as Markdown. Answers are read from the published catalogue and never contain class times.

skills.name: Published page as Markdown
skills.description: Given the path of a public Vuzora page, returns the curated Markdown mirror the release publishes for it.
